name: Natural uranium
why: Feed for all enriched fission fuel

name: Highly enriched uranium
why: Most compact reactor cores (Kilopower used HEU)

name: Uranium-molybdenum alloy fuel
why: Cast metal core of the KRUSTY Kilopower test reactor

name: Uranium-zirconium hydride fuel
why: Self-moderating fuel of SNAP-10A, the only US reactor flown in orbit

name: TRISO fuel particles
why: Coated fuel particles that retain fission products at high temperature

name: Tungsten-UO2 cermet fuel
why: Candidate hot hydrogen-resistant nuclear thermal rocket fuel

name: Neptunium-237
why: Irradiation target from which plutonium-238 is bred

name: Plutonium-238
why: Decay-heat source of radioisotope generators for deep-space probes

name: Thorium
why: Fertile fuel for thorium breeder reactors

name: Depleted uranium
why: Tails of uranium enrichment: dense, cheap radiation and ballast mass
